insights:
- FC Goa and Chennaiyin finished 1‑1, yet Chennaiyin’s expected goals were 0.91 against Goa’s 0.76 – a quick way to see that Chennaiyin had slightly higher quality chances, but both teams scored the same number of times.
- Goa blasted 17 shots (9 on target) while Chennaiyin managed 9 shots (3 on target) – Goa made almost double the attempts but still only one goal each, showing that more shots don’t always translate to more goals.
- Possession split 53 % for Chennaiyin and 47 % for Goa, yet Goa’s accurate passes were 316 versus Chennaiyin’s 367 – a reminder that even with slightly less control, Goa delivered more precise passes.
- Christian Borrego’s 4 shots (0.18 expected) produced Goa’s goal at the 75th minute, while Irfan Yadwad’s 2 shots (0.09 expected) yielded Chennaiyin’s goal at 63 minutes – both players outperformed what their xG suggested.
- Goa recorded no big chances and no big chances missed; Chennaiyin had one big chance, which they missed – despite the miss, the match still ended in a draw.
